headline: New public hearings on special permits and variances for properties on Pickett Ct., Oak St., Kernwood Ave., Virginia Ave., and Emily Way.
summary: The meeting covers new public hearings for special permits and variances at several Beverly properties, a modification to the City Hall addition design, and continued hearings for a wireless facility and a parking lot at 12 Tozer Road.
items: Stanley Greene o/b/o Anne Vallette requests a Special Permit under sections 300-83A(2), 300-83A(2), and 300-83B(2) to build a front porch and small dormer at garage for height at 10 Pickett Ct., Beverly MA, R6 zoning district.

Conor F. Walsh, Esq. o/b/o Scott Bumpus & Debra Durso-Bumpus requests a Special Permit/Finding from sections 300-83(A)(2) and 300-83(A)(1)(b) to construct multiple additions to a 1950s single-family home with a nonconforming side setback of 11 feet (required 15 feet), with a portion reducing setback to 6.9 feet and additions increasing building volume by more than 25 percent, at 45 Oak St., Beverly MA, R10 zoning district.
Jeremy Puz requests a variance from 300-34D(4) D(5) for side and rear setback requirements to convert the existing garage into a new Garage/ADU at 76 Kernwood Ave., Beverly MA, R10 zoning district.
Ralph Rizzo requests a Variance under 300-83A(2) to add a roof to existing front deck at 8 Virginia Ave., Beverly MA, R10 zoning district.
Jason Brownstein requests a Special Permit to build a deck requiring relief from zoning ordinance section 300-83A(2) at 3 Emily Way, Beverly MA, R22 zoning district.
Maria-Anna Hatziliades o/b/o City of Beverly requests a Modification to the addition design for City Hall at 191 Cabot Street, R6 zoning district.

Cellco Partnership d/b/a Verizon Wireless and the Towers, LLC requests a Special Permit under sections 300-42(C)(1)(p) and 300-91 and height and setback Variances from 300-25A to permit a wireless communications facility with a monopole 124 feet in height (including 4' lightning rod) and setback from the property line of approximately 52 feet, at 12 Tozer Road, IR zoning district, Map 68, Parcel 25B.

Conor F. Walsh, Esq. o/b/o 12 Tozer Self Storage Holdings LLC requests a Special Permit to authorize a principal use of the property at 12 Tozer Road as a parking lot under Section 300-41(C)(1)(g), establishing mixed use with the existing self-storage facility and continued accessory off-street parking in the R-10 zoning district.
location: Beverly Police Department Community Room, 175 Elliott Street, Beverly, MA
